description: Add typing cursor animation to Playground input, enhanced code syntax highlighting effect, confetti celebration on successful run, and improved output reveal. Add parallax scroll to About section, animated social icons on hover, image reveal animation, and improved tag rotation. Must preserve Playground state management (name, output, feedback, isRunning) and About social links.
steps: 1. In src/components/sections/Playground.css: Add @keyframes cursor-blink and .input-wrapper::after for blinking cursor effect. Style cursor as vertical bar that blinks when input is focused

2. In src/components/sections/Playground.jsx: Add syntax highlighting effect by wrapping code elements in motion.span with color transition animation. Use variants to highlight 'print', 'f', and string literals with sequential color pulse

3. In src/components/sections/Playground.jsx: Create confetti effect on successful run. Add confetti particles array to state, spawn 20-30 particles with random x,y,rotation when feedback.type === 'success'. Use motion.div for each particle with animate={{ y: 100, opacity: 0, rotate: 360 }}. Clean up after animation

4. In src/components/sections/Playground.jsx: Enhance output reveal with typing effect. Use motion.div with animate={{ width: ['0%', '100%'] }} overflow hidden technique, or character-by-character reveal using staggerChildren

5. In src/components/sections/About.jsx: Add parallax effect using useScroll and useTransform hooks. Transform scrollYProgress to y offset for photo and content at different rates (photo: [0, -30], content: [0, -15])

6. In src/components/sections/About.jsx: Enhance social-link hover with icon animation. Add whileHover={{ rotate: [0, -10, 10, 0], scale: 1.1 }} to icon wrapper. Add transition with type: 'spring' for bouncy feel
7. In src/components/sections/About.jsx: Add image reveal animation to .about-photo using clipPath animation from circle(0%) to circle(100%) on whileInView. Add delay: 0.2 after content fades in

8. In src/components/sections/About.jsx: Improve about-tag rotation with continuous subtle animation using animate={{ rotate: [6, 8, 6] }} with repeat: Infinity and duration: 4. Add hover effect that increases rotation
9. Verify: Run 'npm run build'. Test that Playground name input, run button, and output all function. Verify social links open in new tab.
